app.name: Slack Origin Bridge
app.short_description: Displays Slack origin coordinates and expected reactions
app.long_description: Inspects ticket external IDs matching slack:{team_id}:{channel_id}:{message_ts}, displays Slack origin coordinates with deep links, and shows the configured Zendesk-to-Slack reaction mapping.
app.installation_instructions: Upload this package as a private Zendesk Support app in Admin Center.
